description: The donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different types of stimuli used in the context of generative AI’s application in journalism, as referenced in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into ten distinct segments, each labeled with a stimulus category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is “Draft/Other” at 26.4%, followed by “Press Release” at 18.7% and “External News Article” at 18.1%. Other notable categories include “Interview” (8.8%), “Organizational Report” (7.7%), and “Event Posting” (6.6%). Smaller segments include “Organizational Website” and “Intra-agency news article,” both at 4.9%, “Email” at 2.7%, “Social Media Post” at 1.1%, and a small unlabeled sliver likely representing a negligible remainder. Each segment is color-coded with a unique shade, and percentage values are displayed adjacent to their respective labels. The chart uses a neutral gray background with dark gray text, and the central hole contains the title “Stimulus Type” in bold, emphasizing the categorical nature of the data. No legend is present, as labels are directly associated with each slice. The segments appear to be ordered clockwise from the top-right, starting with “Draft/Other,” though not strictly by size.
